symptom: ruff 0.0.277 panics ('range start index 2 out of range for slice of length 1' in rules/isort/block.rs) while building isort blocks for the I001 rule when consecutive import statements carry '# isort: skip' trailing comments, as in ipykernel's debugger module. The panic is reported as a warning and ruff still exits 0. Fixed by astral-sh/ruff PR #5623, released in 0.0.278.
